verdict.rationale: GoDaddy documents an availability-check endpoint, alternative-name discovery from keywords or natural-language queries, and an account-free MCP search tool, so the core search capability is real. However, the 'honest, no lookup-then-squat' part of the story is directly undercut by specific community reports that GoDaddy registered names users had searched (front-running), and GoDaddy offers no documented counter-commitment. Missing for 10: any documented guarantee against front-running of searched names, evidence of search speed or latency, explicit alternate-TLD suggestions (the docs only say 'alternative names'), and independent hands-on corroboration of search quality.
